home_intro.heading: Review AGRIBALYSE 3.2 on ecoinvent
home_intro.lead: Explore ADEME’s published data, follow the evidence behind individual cases and compare the results of rebuilding the inventory on ecoinvent 3.9.1.

description: Browse AGRIBALYSE 3.2, check community findings against ADEME’s release and follow the results of the ecoinvent build.
